'''Phizbin Marsh''' was located on the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]], partly surrounding the city of [[Ugnorgrad/Legends|Ugnorgrad]]. A significant portion of the [[Ugnorgrad Swampway]] course ran through the [[Swamp/Legends|marsh]].<ref name="ActionTidings2" />
